_doc: Rule 3 (rule set v2): all seeded broken links and all seeded ambiguous links, and nothing else. broken_links: (from, line, target as written), reason missing_note. ambiguous_links: (from, line, target as written, candidate paths), reason ambiguous: a short link whose name matches several notes resolves to nothing (owner's decision). Exact paths to the shared name are not ambiguous. The result must not carry unlinked_notes. Traps that must NOT appear: links inside code (Snippets/Code Samples.md), links in .obsidian/ and .git/ files, the URL link in Home.md, the symlinks escape.md and outside/.
